name: Greptile Security Agent
desc: AI security agent paired with static scanning on every pull request.
desc_zh: 与静态扫描搭配、在每个 Pull Request 上工作的 AI 安全智能体。
solves: Scanners report rules that a human still has to judge; the agent reads the surrounding code and says which findings are real.
solves_zh: 扫描器按规则报问题，真假仍要人判断；智能体会读周边代码，指出哪些发现是真的。
best_for: Your scanner output is mostly noise and the team has stopped reading it.
best_for_zh: 扫描结果大多是噪音，团队已经不再看了。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — greptile.com/changelog directory）。 Distinct from the security review beta of 2026-04-13. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：官方名字只是「Security Agent」，加上产品名以便辨认。 首次公开日期来源：https://www.greptile.com/changelog
